title: Single-molecule kinetic exploration of functional sub-states in an evolving phosphotriesterase

hypotheses.hypothesis: Functional optimization is tightly coupled to redistribution of conformational sub-states

title: Sometimes extracellular recordings fail for good reasons
task: Explain why homogeneous excitable tissues generate little or no detectable extracellular electrical potentials
key_results: Mathematically demonstrated that isolated cells with uniform ion channel distributions and homogeneous coupled tissues produce zero extracellular potentials during non-propagating action potentials; EPs require spatial inhomogeneities, propagating waves, or applied currents.
comments: This theoretical insight reconciles long-standing empirical observations of weak or absent extracellular signals in certain systems and highlights the importance of cellular/tissue heterogeneity for detectability in electrophysiology.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Homogeneous cells produce detectable extracellular potentials
